title: Context-aware caution banners, clinician edit tracking, and one-click re-evaluation

test_cases.name: CautionClassifier severity tier classification
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect CautionClassifier class and classify method in index.html
test_cases.expected_result: Issues classified into normalized severity tiers
test_cases.evidence: CautionClassifier maps validation issues to critical/warning/info tiers

test_cases.name: Inline caution banners adjacent to affected fields
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect inline caution rendering targeting data-field attributes
test_cases.expected_result: Inline cautions attached directly to field elements
test_cases.evidence: Inline cautions render visually adjacent to affected clinical fields

test_cases.name: Doctor inline field modification tracking
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect FieldEditTracker and field-edited CSS classes in index.html
test_cases.evidence: Field edit tracking captures doctor edits on clinical fields

test_cases.name: One-click re-run reasoning with section-isolated refresh
test_cases.input_setup: Check for ReRunReasoningController and rerun action bar
test_cases.evidence: Re-run action bar and controller defined with section-isolated loading

test_cases.name: Re-run attempt limit prevents infinite loops
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect ReRunReasoningController for MAX_RERUNS and limit notice
test_cases.expected_result: Re-run disabled after max threshold (2 attempts) with notice
test_cases.evidence: Re-run bounded with maximum attempt enforcement to prevent infinite loops
